description: Fictional climbing and bouldering media approved for Alphane README mockups. Years, stories, people, and productions are invented.

items.title: Granite Summer
items.overview: Three friends spend a summer learning the granite walls beyond their hometown.
items.art: Warm 35mm film grain, a faded cream camper van, sunlit granite and friends wearing early-1990s climbing clothes. Nostalgic adventure-drama cover with understated cream serif lettering.

items.title: Static on the Ridge
items.overview: When a storm cuts off radio contact, a climbing team must find its own way home.
items.art: Storm clouds over a jagged mountain ridge, a small roped climbing team and an unbranded handheld radio in the foreground. Early-1990s adventure thriller, deep blue shadows and bold red condensed title lettering.

items.title: Pocket Full of Granite
items.overview: A borrowed van and a bag of chalk turn a weekend away into an unlikely bouldering road trip.
items.art: A cheerful bouldering road trip, rounded granite boulders, a battered turquoise van, climbers in bright 1994 windbreakers. Playful 1990s hand-lettered title, sunny amber and turquoise, film grain.

items.title: Camp at Mile Nine
items.overview: At a mountain campsite, a group of newcomers discovers that every climb begins with trust.
items.art: Hand-painted 1990s family adventure cover, an inviting mountain campsite, orange tents beneath pines, low climbing rocks and a mountain lake. Rich forest green and sunset orange, warm storybook realism, painted cream title lettering.

items.title: Crux at Midnight
items.overview: A night rescue forces two climbers to face the wall that once divided them.
items.art: 1997 cinematic adventure-thriller cover, two properly roped climbers on an exposed granite wall at night, piercing headlamp beams, distant storm glow. Dramatic silhouettes, midnight blue, silver metallic condensed title.

items.title: The Last Chalkbag
items.overview: Old climbing partners return to the valley where they first learned to climb together.
items.art: 1999 independent adventure-drama cover, weathered chalk bag and old climbing rope in the foreground, two friends at the foot of a hazy granite valley. Muted earth tones, textured analogue photography, elegant ivory title lettering.

items.title: Beneath the Chalk
items.overview: One difficult boulder problem reveals the patience behind every small improvement.
items.art: Contemporary intimate bouldering documentary cover, anatomically natural chalked hands gripping a small rough granite edge, floating chalk dust in side light. Crisp macro texture, slate and ivory, quiet modern documentary title typography.

items.title: Basalt Days
items.overview: A coastal climbing community follows the tides along a forgotten stretch of basalt.
items.art: Contemporary climbing documentary cover, dark basalt sea-cliff columns and sea spray, a tiny properly roped climber wearing an orange jacket. Monumental wide coastal composition, steel blue and orange, clean modern white title lettering.

items.title: Between Two Holds
items.overview: A climber works through the moves, doubts, and friendships beneath a limestone roof.
items.art: Contemporary climbing documentary cover, a properly roped climber silhouetted below a broad pale limestone overhang, bright sky behind the natural rock arch. Ochre limestone and cyan sky, a striking diagonal composition, minimalist white title typography.

items.title: Small Stone, Big World
items.overview: A woodland boulder brings together a community with very different reasons to climb.
items.art: Contemporary bouldering community documentary cover, mossy woodland granite boulder, friends carrying crash pads along a forest path, dappled green light. Intimate natural photography, lush greens, thoughtful ivory title lettering.

items.title: Blue Hour on Granite
items.overview: Long alpine days end in the brief blue light between the final pitch and the walk home.
items.art: Contemporary alpine climbing documentary cover, indigo mountain silhouettes at blue hour, a vast granite wall with tiny roped climbers and a warm headlamp glow. Expansive contemplative photography, cobalt and lavender, refined pale title lettering.

items.title: The Quiet Approach
items.overview: Through misty trails and early starts, climbers reflect on the journeys before the first hold.
items.art: Contemporary contemplative climbing documentary cover, two climbers carrying unbranded crash pads walking a misty pine trail toward distant rocks, expansive soft landscape. Sage green and fog white, elegant understated title lettering.

items.title: Chalk up!
items.overview: A group of friends explores woodland boulders, shared projects, and small victories through a season of bouldering.
items.art: Daylight bouldering season cover with four fictional friends carrying crash pads, chalked hands, and low bouldering with a spotter. No sport-climbing imagery. Energetic ivory Chalk up! lettering.

items.title: After the Gym Closes
items.overview: The staff and regulars of a small bouldering gym find that the hardest problems are off the wall.
items.art: Contemporary ensemble comedy series cover, three fictional adult gym staff chatting beneath colorful bouldering holds after closing, warm welcoming gym interior, coral and mustard tones. Playful bold cream title typography.

items.title: Routes We Haven’t Taken
items.overview: Two climbing partners travel through unfamiliar valleys in search of routes and unexpected friendships.
items.art: Contemporary climbing travel documentary series cover, two climbers beside an unbranded van overlooking a vast fictional sandstone valley at dawn, broad landscape with winding road. Terracotta and pale blue, modern cinematic white title typography.

items.title: Brushwork
items.overview: An intimate look at the craft, care, and quiet routines of bouldering.
items.art: Contemporary craft-focused bouldering documentary series cover, close-up of a climber carefully brushing chalk from a rough rock hold with an unbranded wooden brush. Natural tactile rock texture, ochre and chalk white, precise minimalist title typography.

items.title: Belay Station
items.overview: In a mountain town, a climbing community navigates ambition, friendship, and the pull of home.
items.art: Contemporary prestige drama series cover, portraits of three entirely fictional adult climbers against a misty fictional mountain town, restrained cinematic composition. Charcoal, forest green and muted warm skin tones, elegant serif white title typography.

items.title: Crag Kids
items.overview: Curious young adventurers learn to climb, solve problems, and look after their mountain playground.
items.art: Original cheerful illustrated animated family climbing series cover, three original child adventurers with helmets and harnesses on a low colorful climbing rock, a friendly woodland setting. Rounded expressive original character design, pastel orange and leafy green, playful large title lettering. Do not imitate any existing animation franchise.

episodes.title: Last Light
episodes.overview: With daylight fading, the crew returns to a granite boulder for one last attempt—and discovers that a shared project can mean more than the send.

episodes.title: New Lines
episodes.overview: A new valley brings unfamiliar rock, fresh possibilities, and a chance for everyone to find their own line.

episodes.title: Closing Time
episodes.overview: An unexpectedly late customer interrupts the crew’s plans for a quiet evening.

episodes.title: A Way Back
episodes.overview: A familiar route brings two old friends back to a conversation they left unfinished.
